turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Let me look at the radio first. Welsy, Elizabeth, the shelter and water are on you two.
turns.stage_direction: Sam crouches by the wreckage and opens his toolkit, examining the radio's casing and wiring.
turns.visible_action: Sam opened the radio casing with the toolkit and studied the circuitry.
turns.state_change: Sam privately learned the radio is working.
turns.private_result: Diagnosis: the radio WORKS. It only needs someone to send a distress call.
turns.current_plan: Diagnose radio, repair if possible, then call rescue. Others handle shelter and water.
turns.reason: Knowing if the radio works decides everything; I am the only one who can do it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: The radio works! Sending the distress call now. Boat takes two at the shoreline after the storm starts.
turns.stage_direction: Sam leans to the radio, presses the transmit key and speaks into the handset.
turns.visible_action: Sam sent a distress call. A voice crackled back: "Patrol boat confirms: two places at the shoreline pickup point, after the storm front, final pickup."
turns.state_change: Distress call succeeded: the boat will come for two people at the final pickup.
turns.previous_plan: Diagnose radio, repair if possible, then call rescue. Others handle shelter and water.
turns.current_plan: Call rescue now, then tell others about the two-seat boat, the shelter, and water testing.
turns.reason: Diagnosis showed the radio works and only needs a call; no boat comes without it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Elizabeth, grab the other bottle. I'll build a shelter at the dry spot, and we should get Sam moving.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy scoops up one water bottle and nods toward the other bottle for Elizabeth, then glances up the beach.
turns.current_plan: Take bottle, get Sam to dry spot via assist, build shelter with rope, have everyone take shelter; test water with Elizabeth.
turns.reason: Radio call succeeded; storm is coming so water and shelter are priority.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Sam, lean on me. Elizabeth, bring bottle 2 and come along. We're going to the dry spot.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy slips under Sam's arm, rope coiled on her shoulder, and helps him up toward the dry spot. She nods to Elizabeth to follow.
turns.visible_action: Welsy got Sam up, looping the rope under his arms, and helped him over to the dry spot up the beach.
turns.previous_plan: Take bottle, get Sam to dry spot via assist, build shelter with rope, have everyone take shelter; test water with Elizabeth.
turns.current_plan: Assist Sam to dry spot, build shelter, everyone take shelter, test water with Elizabeth. Later someone goes to shoreline for boat.
turns.reason: Time is limited and the shelter must be built at the dry spot, so I need to get Sam moving now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Building the shelter now. Elizabeth, bring bottle 2 here, then we all get under it.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy gathers driftwood and lashes it into a low roof frame with her rope.
turns.visible_action: Welsy gathered driftwood and plane debris from the beach and lashed them together with her rope into a wooden storm shelter at the dry spot.
turns.state_change: Shelter built at the dry spot; the rope is now part of it.
turns.previous_plan: Assist Sam to dry spot, build shelter, everyone take shelter, test water with Elizabeth. Later someone goes to shoreline for boat.
turns.current_plan: Build shelter now, then everyone take_shelter with bottles; get Elizabeth to test water; decide who goes to shoreline for boat.
turns.reason: Sam is at the dry spot and wood is available, so the shelter is the key step to survive the storm.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Boat takes two at the shoreline, shelter saves the third if water's clean. Elizabeth, bring bottle 2 here. Let's decide together.
turns.stage_direction: Sam leans against the shelter post and gestures between the shoreline and the roof, looking at Welsy and then down the beach toward Elizabeth.
turns.visible_action: Sam made an offer to everyone: "Boat takes two at the shoreline; the third shelters with clean water. We test water, decide together, and the rescued send help back."
turns.state_change: Open offer (Sam → everyone). Nothing has changed hands.
turns.previous_plan: Call rescue now, then tell others about the two-seat boat, the shelter, and water testing.
turns.current_plan: Share the two-seat boat and shelter tradeoff, get bottle 2 to the dry spot, agree who boards, then act.
turns.reason: Others may not fully know the boat limit; coordination is needed before anyone commits, and the water is unverified.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Give me a moment. I'm testing this water before anyone relies on it.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth kneels by bottle 2, opens her first-aid kit and prepares a test strip.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth opened a water bottle and tested it with a strip from the first-aid kit.
turns.state_change: Elizabeth privately learned the water is contaminated.
turns.private_result: Water test: CONTAMINATED. Neither bottle is safe to drink.
turns.current_plan: Test the water, then take bottle 2 to the dry spot and share the result. Then settle with Sam and Welsy who goes to the shoreline.
turns.reason: Everything depends on whether the water is clean, and only I can test it.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Both bottles are contaminated, I tested them. The shelter won't save anyone. The boat is our only way. Let's choose the two now.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth holds up the used test strip so the others can see it, then calls up the beach.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth made an offer to everyone: "Water is contaminated, so the shelter can't save anyone. Only the boat can. Two of us board at the shoreline, and whoever goes sends help back for the third."
turns.state_change: Open offer (Elizabeth → everyone). Nothing has changed hands.
turns.previous_plan: Test the water, then take bottle 2 to the dry spot and share the result. Then settle with Sam and Welsy who goes to the shoreline.
turns.current_plan: Share the result, agree who takes the two boat places (Sam's mobility matters), head to the shoreline, and make sure help is sent back for whoever stays.
turns.reason: The water is contaminated, so the shelter is useless and only the two boat places can save lives. The others need this to decide.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Elizabeth, I can't test it myself, so I'll trust you. Sam, lean on me. We go to the shoreline. Elizabeth, meet us there.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy loops the rope under Sam's arms, keeps the bottle, and helps him toward the shoreline. She waves Elizabeth to follow.
turns.visible_action: Welsy got Sam up and helped him over to the shoreline pickup point.
turns.previous_plan: Build shelter now, then everyone take_shelter with bottles; get Elizabeth to test water; decide who goes to shoreline for boat.
turns.current_plan: Get Sam to the shoreline, gather everyone there, settle who boards fairly, and keep the promise to send help back.
turns.reason: Elizabeth reports contaminated water, so the shelter is unreliable and the boat is the only sure survival. Everyone needs to be at the shoreline.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Welsy, I'm committing to the boat. Take the second seat. Elizabeth, I promise we'll send help back for you right away.
turns.stage_direction: Sam braces against the wind at the waterline, plants himself at the pickup point and raises a hand to signal he is committing to board. He looks to Welsy.
turns.visible_action: Sam planted himself at the shoreline pickup point, committed to boarding.
turns.state_change: Sam committed to boarding (position 1 in line).
turns.previous_plan: Share the two-seat boat and shelter tradeoff, get bottle 2 to the dry spot, agree who boards, then act.
turns.current_plan: Secure a boat seat now, urge Welsy to take the other, and send help back for whoever stays.
turns.reason: Water reported contaminated, so the boat is the only sure survival. Seats go to the first two committed, and I'm already at the shoreline.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Welsy, commit to the boat now before Elizabeth gets here. We'll send help back for her right away.
turns.stage_direction: Sam grips the toolkit and looks at Welsy through the driving rain, nodding toward the waiting spot beside him.
turns.visible_action: Sam made an offer to Welsy: "Welsy, commit to boarding now and take the second seat. We send help back for Elizabeth the moment we're rescued."
turns.state_change: Open offer (Sam → Welsy). Nothing has changed hands.
turns.previous_plan: Secure a boat seat now, urge Welsy to take the other, and send help back for whoever stays.
turns.current_plan: Get Welsy to commit to the second seat, then promise and follow through on sending help back for Elizabeth.
turns.reason: Only two seats go to the first two to commit. Welsy hasn't committed yet and Elizabeth could take the seat first.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: I'm coming to the shoreline. Welsy, Sam, please wait. Let's settle the second seat fairly, and send help back for whoever stays.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth grips the first-aid kit and hurries through the rain toward the shoreline.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth walked from the wreckage to the shoreline pickup point.
turns.previous_plan: Share the result, agree who takes the two boat places (Sam's mobility matters), head to the shoreline, and make sure help is sent back for whoever stays.
turns.current_plan: Reach the shoreline, talk with Welsy and Sam about the second seat, and get a firm promise to send help back.
turns.reason: Sam is committed and wants Welsy to take the second seat before I arrive. The only way to take part in the decision is to be at the shoreline.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Time's nearly gone. I'm committing, Elizabeth. I'll send help back for you first thing. I'm sorry.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy lowers Sam's arm from her shoulder, steps onto the pickup mark beside him, and faces the water. She glances back at Elizabeth.
turns.visible_action: Welsy planted herself at the shoreline pickup point, committed to boarding.
turns.state_change: Welsy committed to boarding (position 2 in line).
turns.previous_plan: Get Sam to the shoreline, gather everyone there, settle who boards fairly, and keep the promise to send help back.
turns.current_plan: Board with Sam, then send help back for Elizabeth as promised.
turns.reason: Only two turns remain. The water is reported contaminated, so the shelter can't save anyone and the boat is the only way to survive. Sam already holds one seat.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Sam, Welsy, go. Please send help back for me the moment you land. Tell them I'm at the shoreline.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth steadies herself against the wind and looks at Sam and Welsy. She holds out the first-aid kit toward Sam.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth made an offer to everyone: "You two board. Send help back for me the moment you're rescued, and tell them exactly where the shoreline is."
turns.state_change: Open offer (Elizabeth → everyone). Nothing has changed hands.
turns.previous_plan: Reach the shoreline, talk with Welsy and Sam about the second seat, and get a firm promise to send help back.
turns.current_plan: Accept that the seats are taken, get a firm promise of rescue, and hand Sam the kit for his leg. Remain at the shoreline in case a seat opens.
turns.reason: Both seats are committed and the water is contaminated, so the best remaining outcome is two rescued and a firm promise to send help back for me.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Elizabeth, thank you. I swear we'll send help straight back for you at the shoreline. Hold on.
turns.stage_direction: Sam grips the toolkit and looks at Elizabeth, nodding solemnly. He steadies himself against Welsy as the waves reach the sand.
turns.visible_action: Sam accepted Elizabeth's offer from turn 14: "Welsy and I board; we send help back for Elizabeth at the shoreline immediately."
turns.state_change: Offer from turn 14 accepted (still only words).
turns.previous_plan: Get Welsy to commit to the second seat, then promise and follow through on sending help back for Elizabeth.
turns.current_plan: Stay committed at the shoreline, board with Welsy, and send help back for Elizabeth.
turns.reason: Elizabeth agreed to stay; Sam and Welsy are committed, so accept and keep the promise to send help back.

how.A: boarded the patrol boat at the final pickup
how.B: boarded the patrol boat at the final pickup
how.C: was at the shoreline but never committed to boarding

outcome.A: rescued: boarded the patrol boat at the final pickup
outcome.B: rescued: boarded the patrol boat at the final pickup
outcome.C: did not survive the storm: was at the shoreline but never committed to boarding

ending.finalBeat: The patrol boat pulls in for the final pickup; Sam and Welsy board and it heads out as the storm breaks. As promised, they will send help back for Elizabeth.
